description: Figure 7 shows the distribution of different task types across turns from verified Wildchat journalist-LLM conversations. The second section shows the distribution of task types for Agency B, with the largest slice representing "Article generation" at 82.9%. The third section shows the distribution of task types for the aggregated data across both agencies, with the largest slice representing "Article generation" at 83.1%. The chart is color-coded, with each task type represented by a different color. The chart is a pie chart, with each slice representing a different task type and its proportion of the total. The chart is a visual representation of the distribution of different task types across turns from verified Wildchat journalist-LLM conversations.
